guidance.heading: Outlook for Full-Year 2026
section: •Full-year 2026 net sales guidance increased to a range of $3.41 billion to $3.42 billion, up from the previous range of $3.345 billion to $3.380 billion.
•Full-year 2026 adjusted-diluted EPS guidance increased to a range of $9.38 to $9.48, up from the previous range of $8.85 to $9.05.

Michel Lagarde, President and Chief Executive Officer, commented: “I am pleased to report strong third-quarter 2026 results, with net sales and adjusted EPS exceeding our expectations. Our results were again led by our High-Value Product (HVP) Components business. The robust sales performance drove strong operating income margin expansion and EPS growth. As a result of our team's strong execution in the third quarter, we are increasing our full-year 2026 guidance.”

Mr. Lagarde concluded: “I want to thank our global teams for their relentless focus on execution to deliver products and services for our customers and the patients they serve. West is a critical primary containment and drug delivery partner for pharmaceutical companies, biotechs and CDMOs around the world. We are grateful for the trust our customers put in us, and we remain committed to driving continuous improvement to even better serve their current and future needs.”
